children: Opus Genetics reported positive safety and proof-of-concept results from low-dose Cohort 1 of OPGx-BEST1 with functional and structural gains in treated patients.
All 5 Cohort 1 participants (1.5x10⁹ vg/eye) showed clinically meaningful visual-function improvement; 4/5 had structural gains.
Safety profile favorable: no serious adverse events, no dose-limiting toxicities, no intraocular inflammation; AEs mild/moderate.
Microperimetry improved in 75% of evaluable participants (3/4); BCVA improved in 60% (3/5), LLVA and contrast sensitivity improved in 40% (2/5).
Cohort 2 advanced to 4.5x10⁹ vg/eye, over-enrolled at 8 participants; dosing expected complete Q4 2026, topline 3‑month data expected Q2 2027.
FDA Type C meeting alignment: potential pivotal endpoint ≥3 dB microperimetry improvement in ≥5 loci plus a patient‑reported outcome; Phase 3 and commercial CMC on schedule.
